methods.help: Decodes a source once and runs each pipeline on it. Returns one result per pipeline, in the same order.

enums.name: Format
enums.help: An image file format. `Image::format` sets the format that `encode` writes.

enums.name: Gravity
enums.help: A position in an image, as a direction from the center. `resize` uses it to choose which part of the image it keeps.

enums.name: Fit
enums.help: How `resize` fits an image into the width and height you give.

enums.name: Filter
enums.help: The filter `resize` uses to calculate the new pixels. The default is `Lanczos3`.

enums.name: Axis
enums.help: The direction `flip` mirrors an image in.

enums.name: Blend
enums.help: How the pixels of one image are mixed with the pixels of the image below it.

enums.name: Align
enums.help: How the lines of a text are aligned.

enums.name: Output
enums.help: What `Codec::run` returns: the encoded file, the RGBA8 pixels, or the size alone.
